plan.notes: Source: official Bunker Hill Community College catalog (catalog.bhcc.edu), College Catalog 2025-2026 (program page dated Feb 03, 2026): https://catalog.bhcc.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=13&poid=1459 . Official program title: 'Program: Computer Science Transfer Option, A.S.' BHCC also offers a separate 'Computer Science Concentration, A.A.'; this plan uses the A.S. Computer Science Transfer Option, BHCC's true CS degree. Transcription method: manual transcription of the catalog's official term-by-term sequence (Semester 1 through Semester 4). Catalog year verified on the program page header ('College Catalog 2025 - 2026'). Course credits and official prerequisite lines verified against the catalog's Course Descriptions pages (catalog.bhcc.edu/content.php?catoid=13&navoid=678, cpages 2-7). CREDIT HONESTY: the published sequence prints term totals as ranges - Semester 1: 17-18, Semester 2: 15, Semester 3: 16-17, Semester 4: 13-16 (degree range 61-66 credits). The catalog prints no single degree total; total_credits is set to 61, the sequence's own published minimum, and variable-credit slots use their minimum (GenEd-E 3-4 -> 3; Option Electives 3-4 -> 3). A student taking 4-credit options reaches up to 66 credits. No courses, credits, or prerequisites were invented. PREREQS: in-plan college-level prereqs are in prereq arrays; MAT-194 (College Algebra-STEM) and MAT-197 (Precalculus) are the official course prerequisites behind CSC-237/CSC-239 (MAT-194), CSC-242/CSC-285 (MAT-197), and MAT-281 (MAT-197) and are listed in external_prereqs as plain codes. Developmental/placement-level prerequisites (MAT-099, RDG-095, ENG-095/ELL-103, ESL-098) are placement-only and documented here, not in prereq arrays. The catalog marks CSC-120, CSC-237, CSC-239, and CSC-285 as Milestone Courses to be taken in the order shown. Advising notes from the program page: (1) GenEd Quantitative Problem Solving and Scientific Reasoning requirements are satisfied by the program; (2) new degree-seeking students in 9+ credits must take a Learning Community Seminar or cluster in their first year; (3) transfer guidance for UMass Boston (CSC-240 at UMB), UMass Lowell/Amherst (take MAT-291 as an elective), and Tufts (take MAT-283).
